original_research: Ethics, registration, data sharing plan, funding, and conflicts of interest

encoding_notes: Publisher migration: Acta Orthopaedica left Taylor & Francis and is now an immediate open-access journal published by MJS Publishing – Medical Journals Sweden for the Nordic Orthopaedic Federation. tandfonline NOT used.

Article-type mapping: 'Original (clinical or experimental)' -> original_research; 'Reviews' (incl. scoping/rapid) -> review; 'Systematic Review' (incl. meta-analysis / network meta-analysis) -> systematic_review; 'Case/Technical Reports' (combined) -> case_report + technical_note; 'Editorials' -> editorial; 'Letter to the editor' -> letter.

Omitted types with no clean schema slot: 'Educationals' (teaching content; 3300 words, no abstract, up to 40 refs, max 10 combined figures/tables/text boxes), 'Perspectives' (1200 words, up to 10 refs, no figures/tables), and 'Guidelines' (only 'may also be considered').
Introduction has its own cap: 'should not exceed 300 words' — a per-section limit the word_limits schema cannot hold.

Title page must also carry the Introduction word count (total, Abstract, Introduction) — no schema element for introduction word count. Keywords and 'level of evidence' must NOT appear on the title page.
authors_degrees=strip: 'Do not provide academic titles for the authors'; corresponding author gives email only (no postal address/phone).

Open (non-blind) review: 'authors' and reviewers' names are mutually disclosed, unless a reviewer actively chooses to be anonymous' -> double_blind=false. separate_title_page=true because a distinct title page carries author info + word counts and is excluded from the manuscript word count.

Reference style: 'Number the references consecutively and give their number within parenthesis in the text'; DOI added when available; general cap 'Try to limit the numbers of references to 25' (per-type caps: case/editorial/perspective/letter 10, original 25, review/educational up to 40). Guide cites 'NLM Uniform Requirements' — encoded as vancouver/nlm; no et al. author threshold stated.

Figures: 'include tables and figures at the end of the manuscript' -> separate_files=false, tables placement=grouped_end, legends_location inferred as end-of-manuscript legends section. Tiered DPI: photos ~300 DPI (~85 mm/1000 px wide, CMYK for color); black-and-white line drawings 800 DPI 1-bit TIFF (TIFF preferred). Vector graphs exportable as EMF/EPS/SVG/PDF — EMF and SVG accepted by the guide but not in the schema figure-format enum, so only tif/tiff/eps/pdf encoded. Figure fonts must be sans serif (Arial/Helvetica). Figure/text callout style ('Figure' vs 'Fig.') not stated.

line_numbers set to 'continuous' from 'line numbered' (guide does not specify continuous vs per-page). page_size, body font/size, margins, alignment, page numbers, running head, heading styles all UNSTATED -> null/false.
Case/Technical report abstract is required at submission but NOT included in the published version.

Declarations grouped in a single required manuscript section 'Ethics, registration, data sharing plan, funding, and conflicts of interest' placed after the Statistics subheading; author contributions and acknowledgments follow before References. Ethics approval/trial registration/data-sharing are conditionally required (e.g., data-sharing plan for trials enrolling from 1 Jan 2019); funding/conflict-of-interest/author-contributions treated as always-required.
American English spelling required; reporting-guideline checklist (CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA etc.) uploaded as supplementary file.

2026-07-25 Janine live-guide verification (actaorthop.org/actao/instructionsforauthors): line_spacing 'double' CONFIRMED against the guide's own sentence - "It should be double line spaced (also the reference list), line numbered and include tables and figures at the end of the manuscript." The same sentence also confirms layout.line_numbers='continuous'. NOTE for future encoders: the OJS 'Submission Preparation Checklist' on actaorthop.org/actao/about/submissions says "The text is single-spaced" - that is platform boilerplate, NOT this journal's instruction, and it contradicts the actual guide. Do not encode from the checklist.
